name: Lemon Chicken with Celery, Apple, Blue Cheese & Pecan "Waldorf" Salad

instructions.primary_message: Transfer pecans to a baking sheet pan. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until pecans are golden and fragrant, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
9 sticks celery
3 Granny Smith apples
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine. (Reserve lemon for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Sprinkle with the lemon seasoning on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, juice the reserved lemons into a large bowl. Add yogurt, mayo, honey, additional salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Set remaining parsley aside for serving.)
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop the cooled pecans. Add to the bowl, along with the blue cheese, and gently stir to combine the "Waldorf" salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Divide between plates.
To serve, top lettuce with Waldorf salad and divide chicken between plates. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
